figures.alt: Commercial planning workspace with abstract plans and estimating tools
figures.caption: Bonding and qualification start with a defined scope, responsible parties, and documentation that can be reviewed. Good paperwork reflects real capacity rather than a generic promise.

figures.caption: Larger commercial work combines structure, schedule, and trade coordination. A subcontractor's package should make its exclusions, interfaces, and manpower plan clear before work is awarded.
